facts: Computerized English test: reading + vocabulary
Question types: sentence completion, restatements, reading comprehension
Registration fee 315 NIS
Date change fee 142 NIS
Change after test day: ~45% of registration fee
Min 35 days between tests (next test allowed on day 35)
Scores in personal area within 10 days; not emailed
Adaptive test
Chapters: 1 SC, 2 SC, 3 RC, 4 restatement, 5 restatement, 6 SC
7 or 8 chapters; 8: last two experimental; 7: last chapter experimental writing task
Duration about 50 minutes
Per-chapter time limits; no return to previous chapter; unanswered = wrong
Scale 50-150, equivalent to psychometric English
Experimental: wrong answers don't lower score, correct add up to 2 points
Latecomers up to 15 min may be admitted if seats allow
Restroom time deducted from test time
Gradual change from 2027: listening + writing, later speaking (CHE decision 17.12.2019)
Computer only, no speaking/writing assessed currently
Times: ch1,2,6 = 4 min; ch3 = 15 min; ch4,5 = 6 min
Experimental types: lecture/conversation questions 7 min (3 clips), listening continuation 4 min (4 clips ~20s), word formation 3 min (4 q), grammar in context 4 min (4 q), writing task 12 min
Either two experimental sections (types 1-4) or one writing task
Entry opens 20 min before; late arrivals cannot take test
Prohibited: phones, smartwatches, earphones, electronics, dictionaries
One draft sheet only; no food, closed-bottle drinks only
Can advance early only after answering all questions in chapter
Final score on screen incl. experimental; official within 10 working days
3 practice tests in one interactive link
No score given
Chrome, min 1920x1080
Scale 50-150
Equivalent to Amir/Amiram and psychometric English
Each institution sets its own level decisions; no thresholds published on page
English separated from psychometric from December 2026 (notice-15022026)
Two-domain psychometric from December 2026
20 three-domain exams with English: Winter 2021 to Autumn 2026
